title: Furniture Removals Birmingham & West Midlands
metaTitle: Furniture Removals Birmingham | Single Items & Full Suites
metaDescription: Professional furniture removals across Birmingham and the West Midlands. Sofas, wardrobes, dining sets, and antiques moved by uniformed movers in Luton vans.
heroHeading: Reliable Furniture Removals Across Birmingham & West Midlands
heroSubheading: Careful collection, transport, and room-of-choice placement for sofas, wardrobes, heavy dining sets, and antique furniture.
summary: Need single large furniture pieces or complete household suites transported safely? Jimmys Removals provides dedicated furniture removals across Birmingham and the West Midlands. Our directly employed movers protect each item with quilted furniture covers, thick transit blankets, and heavy-duty webbing straps inside 3.5-tonne Luton vans equipped with hydraulic tail lifts.
benefits: Hydraulic tail lifts for ground-level loading of heavy items
Heavy-duty protective furniture blankets and quilted sofa covers
Fully insured transport with written fixed quotes

process.title: Tell Us What Needs Moving
process.description: Send photos or descriptions of your furniture items and access conditions at collection and delivery.

process.title: Guaranteed Fixed Quote
process.description: Receive an upfront fixed quote with no hidden extras or surprise fees.

process.title: Protective Wrapping & Loading
process.description: Our movers blanket-wrap each item and secure it to internal van rails with ratchet straps.

process.title: Delivery & Room Placement
process.description: We unload and place each furniture piece in your chosen room, removing transit wrapping.

whatsIncluded: Uniformed, DBS-checked movers and equipped 3.5-tonne Luton van
Heavy furniture blankets and protective mattress bags
Tail lift loading for heavy appliances and solid timber units
Door frame and hallway protection runners
whatsNotIncluded: Hoisting through external windows without prior structural assessment
Electrical or plumbing disconnections of appliances
priceNotes: Priced per job after a quick survey based on furniture size and access requirements.

faqs.question: Can you move heavy solid wood wardrobes or American fridge-freezers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our 3.5-tonne Luton vans feature 500kg hydraulic tail lifts and heavy-duty piano dollies, allowing our two-person crews to move heavy solid timber wardrobes and bulky appliances safely.

faqs.question: Do you protect furniture against rain or transit marks?
faqs.answer: Every furniture piece is wrapped in quilted transit blankets and secured with industrial webbing straps inside clean, carpet-lined vehicle bodies.

faqs.question: Can you collect furniture purchased from private sellers or auctions?
faqs.answer: Yes. We arrange scheduled collections from private addresses, showrooms, or auction houses across the West Midlands, delivering directly to your home.

faqs.question: What is the cost of furniture removals in Birmingham?
faqs.answer: Furniture removals are priced per job after a quick survey. Costs depend on item dimensions, weight, stair access, and transit mileage, with guaranteed fixed quotes provided before booking.
